title: Compliance Bulletin: The Medicare KX Modifier on Insured Plan of Care Visits
content:
**Insured Plan of Care — KX modifier and targeted medical review.** On a payer program where the KX threshold applies, the calendar-year therapy allowed total is the Medicare-reported allowed therapy amount already accrued this calendar year at other providers, as recorded on the plan, plus the allowed amounts of the visits billed in the current calendar year across all of the patient's Medicare Part B plans of care.

- A visit whose allowed amount brings that total **above** the KX threshold amount carries the KX modifier, attesting that continued therapy is medically necessary, and every later visit in the calendar year carries it too.
- Once the total would exceed the targeted medical review threshold, the plan is flagged for possible targeted medical review and treatment continues with the KX modifier.
- Where the KX threshold does not apply to the payer program, the KX modifier is never applied.
- The threshold is not a hard cap and never by itself makes a visit non-covered.

## Reading the total for one visit

The total that is compared is the accrued amount from other providers, plus the allowed amounts already billed this calendar year on the patient's Medicare Part B plans, plus the allowed amount of the visit being billed. "Above" is strict: a total exactly equal to the threshold does not bring the visit above it.

## Worked example (hypothetical amounts; thresholds of $2480.00 and $3000.00 as scheduled for the Medicare Part B Plan of Care)

| Visit | Accrued at other providers | Billed earlier this year | This visit's allowed amount | Total | KX modifier | Targeted review flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | $1900.00 | $485.00 | $95.00 | $2480.00 | No (equal, not above) | No |
| B | $1900.00 | $580.00 | $95.00 | $2575.00 | Yes | No |
| C | $1900.00 | $1010.00 | $95.00 | $3005.00 | Yes | Yes — treatment continues with the KX modifier |

A visit later in the same calendar year than visit B carries the KX modifier as well.
